title: LOST VAPE THELEMA QUEST 200W KIT
description:
THE LOST VAPE THELEMA QUEST 200W & UB PRO KIT
is an alternative to the high end and well repsect Evolve DNA250 Thelema, incorporating Lost Vape’s very own in-house QUEST 2.0 chipset. Importantly this Quest 2.0 200W chipset has been fitted into the same high end Thelema DNA chassis with only a few very minor difference between them, but a BIG saving on price. The Thelema Quest 200W is both more affordable and still extremely high quality, with a modern and dazzling design, this is one of their most popular mode
Features:
1. 26mm Base Diameter
2. 28mm Widest Diameter
3. 5ml Pod Capacity
4. Side Fill System – Silicone Stoppered
5. Lost Vape UB Pro Coil Series
6. 0.15ohm UB Pro P1 Coil
7. 0.3ohm UB Pro P3 Coil
8. Press Fit Coil Installation
9. Dual Slotted Airflow Control Ring
10. Threaded 510 Connection
Brand: Lost Vape
Unit: 1 Set
Quest 2.0 Chipset
Dimensions – 92.5mm by 56mm by 27.6mm
Dual High-Amp 18650 Batteries – Not Included
Wattage Output Range: 5-200W
Voltage Output Range: 0.7-8.0V
Resistance Range: 0.1-5.0ohm
Temperature Range: 200-600F
Nickel, Titanium, SS Wire Compatibility
Boost Function – Soft, Norm, Hard
Zinc-Alloy + PC Chassis Construction
Intuitive Firing Button
0.96 inch TFT Color Display Screen
Two Adjustment Buttons
Magnetic/Replaceable Battery Door
10S Timeout Protection
Threaded 510 Connection
Type-C USB Port
Package: Gift Box
Includes:
1pc Thelema Quest Box Mod
1pc UB Pro Pod Tank
1pc 0.15ohm UB Pro P1 Coil
1pc 0.3ohm UB Pro P3 Coil
4pc O-Ring
1pc Type-C Cable
1pc Warranty Card
1pc User Manual
